description: This file defines the 'SfnClient' class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the AWS Step Functions service. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to Step Functions.

classes.name: SfnClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with AWS Step Functions service, extending the AwsClient base class.

methods.name: createActivity
methods.description: Creates a new activity in AWS Step Functions.

methods.name: createActivityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new activity in AWS Step Functions.

methods.name: createStateMachineAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new state machine.

methods.name: createStateMachineAlias
methods.description: Creates an alias for a state machine.

methods.name: createStateMachineAliasAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a state machine alias.

methods.name: deleteStateMachineAliasAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a state machine alias.

methods.name: deleteStateMachineVersion
methods.description: Deletes a specific version of a state machine.

methods.name: deleteStateMachineVersionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a state machine version.

methods.name: describeExecution
methods.description: Describes an execution of a state machine.

methods.name: describeMapRun
methods.description: Provides details about a map run.

methods.name: describeStateMachine
methods.description: Provides details about a state machine.

methods.name: describeStateMachineAlias
methods.description: Provides details about a state machine alias.

methods.name: describeStateMachineAliasAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes a state machine alias.

methods.name: describeStateMachineForExecution
methods.description: Describes the state machine for a given execution.

methods.name: describeStateMachineForExecutionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes the state machine for an execution.

methods.name: getActivityTask
methods.description: Retrieves a task for an activity.

methods.name: getExecutionHistory
methods.description: Gets the history of an execution.

methods.name: listExecutions
methods.description: Lists all executions of a state machine.

methods.name: listStateMachineAliases
methods.description: Lists all aliases of a state machine.

methods.name: listStateMachineVersions
methods.description: Lists all versions of a state machine.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: publishStateMachineVersion
methods.description: Publishes a new version of a state machine.

methods.name: publishStateMachineVersionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously publishes a state machine version.

methods.name: sendTaskFailure
methods.description: Sends a task failure for a task.

methods.name: sendTaskHeartbeat
methods.description: Sends a heartbeat for a task.

methods.name: sendTaskSuccess
methods.description: Sends a success response for a task.

methods.name: updateStateMachineAliasAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a state machine alias.

methods.name: validateStateMachineDefinitionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously validates a state machine definition.
